events.name: reject_release
events.reason: Submission missing manifest and artifacts; cannot verify compliance with the Synthetic-data release policy (requires only aggregates with min group size 10, no customer-level rows or synthetic customer identifiers). Rejecting release. To resubmit, provide: 1) a complete manifest describing staged artifacts and aggregation specs; 2) only aggregate outputs (no customer-level rows or synthetic IDs), with every cohort/group size >= 10 and documented counts; 3) description of aggregation methods and any synthesis/anonymization steps; 4) the immutable audit log (unchanged) showing data operations; 5) sample schema and column descriptions; and 6) verification checks (cohort size checks, no identifier columns). Include these in the manifest and re-submit for review.
